verified_sha256.method: Read exact-commit UTF-8 content with GitHub connector; locally calculate SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes; match repository SHA-256 manifest; independently recompute Git blob SHA-1 on content. Hash routine validated against standard empty/abc vectors.

limits: fixed goal predicates and role labels
persistence single-step then implicit event progression

semantic_contract_review.transfer: Physical co-location justified for ordinary physical transfer, but deviates from frozen V6: formalize deliberate amendment or explicitly model remote communication.
semantic_contract_review.carry: Movement of already-held item and propagation of all items is coherent but an unapproved broadening of V6 preconditions/effects.
semantic_contract_review.wait: Atomic clock event order is a needed design repair, but persistence() bypasses WAIT to apply future events; choose explicit passive clock or strict action-timed progression.
semantic_contract_review.retain: No automatic unique oracle from pure safety; RETAIN T2 becomes unique in very narrow stationary, T2-threat motif, not general action-causal novelty.
semantic_contract_review.genesis: T0 initialization axioms can define valid initial custody without a predecessor trace if explicitly preregistered; this is not evidence of historical reachability.
semantic_contract_review.priority: Trigger then request, protection guard inclusive; formalize ordering and concurrent events across types.

constructive_counterexample.reason: No actual typed 32 AST, no 64 canonical comparisons, no independently validated matched-world witnesses; one illustrative scenario or motif cannot veto closure.

findings.title: No 32 admitted typed AST and no canonical OOD certificate
findings.evidence: 32 slot admission matrix: all HOLD_NOT_PROVEN; actual new TRAIN=0 and OOD=0; new 64 TRAIN–OOD pairs not executed

findings.title: Prospective candidate is not frozen V6
findings.evidence: physical co-located TRANSFER, held-target CARRY, atomic WAIT, monotone RETAIN and exogenous request differ from V6 AM01
findings.disposition: amendment required for any successor, not applied

findings.title: Persistence directly advances future events outside WAIT
findings.evidence: constructive_search.py:persistence() calls events_between(out,through) after a single action, including cases with no legal WAIT; WAIT step() requires a pending scheduled trigger
findings.disposition: cannot treat these one-action first-action classifications as complete temporal plan oracle without an explicit passive-clock axiom

findings.title: rule_constraint search includes out-of-category first verb CARRY
findings.evidence: shortest() calls unfiltered actions(); rule_constraint histogram CARRY=18, whereas frozen V6 category allowed actions were TRANSFER, WAIT, RETAIN
findings.disposition: cannot count as four-category construct validity

findings.title: One-fluent criterion undercounts logical exogenous-request interventions
findings.evidence: external_transfer_request is an object with at/item/recipient; switching NONE to T1/T2 can change 3 leaves and is filtered by diff(len)==1
findings.disposition: negative pair count not upper bound for full intervention space

findings.title: No proof of global impossibility
findings.evidence: two agents, items and locations; fixed goal forms, T0–T2, max depth 3, <=1 external request, bounded per-category grammar
findings.disposition: closure is a research management decision only

findings.title: Independent science verification, renderer and custody absent
findings.evidence: 12/12 checks are author-side source tests; renderer/parser/tokenizer not verified, source rights and EVAL custody not executed

decision_rationale: Sufficient to discontinue blueprint generation under this particular formulation because construct validity and admissions are unproven, with no complete constructive counterexample. No full-V6 impossibility claim.
